verdict.rationale: Pipedream's own marketing claims you can "Prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents", and the docs mention debugging errors with AI. That suggests some natural-language operation of the product, but both are single thin mentions with no documentation of how it works. The MCP server lets external agents call third-party APIs, not operate Pipedream itself, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented natural-language interface for building and managing workflows, depth of prompt-driven operation, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
